$comment: TRACKED project settings. This file is in git ON PURPOSE: it is therefore present in
every `git worktree` from the moment the worktree is created, which is the only way a
guard can reach a seat running in one. `.claude/settings.local.json` is personal and
gitignored; hooks that must follow the repo belong HERE.
scar:worktree-agent-memory-written-to-a-doomed-dir-2026-09-11 — a fresh worktree has no
`.claude/agent-memory` symlink, so a seat's memory write silently created a real local
directory that died with the worktree. The PreToolUse hook blocks that write BEFORE any
byte lands; the SessionStart hook warns the seat before it writes anything at all. Both
name `.claude/setup-agent-memory.sh`, which fixes it in one command.
scar:agent-memory-store-ten-days-unpushed-2026-09-11 — the OTHER half of the same
exposure. The symlink rule gets memory into the shared store; nothing got the store
off this box. It sat ten days uncommitted, which is why five of the leaked files were
unrecoverable rather than merely leaked. `--autosave` commits and pushes the store on
SessionStart, Stop and SubagentStop. The seats ARE subagents, so SubagentStop is the
event that actually follows a seat's memory write. There is no timer and no minimum
interval on purpose: a floor reopens the hole at the edge (a write one minute after a
commit, then the session ends, is never banked), and an unchanged store commits
nothing and pushes nothing, so the common path costs one `git status`.
NOT a cron job: the defect being fixed is that nothing went red for ten days. A
scheduled job that stops firing reproduces that class exactly. This runs where a seat
is already looking, so its own failure is printed into the session that depends on it.
The hook is silent and exits 0 on every tool call that is not a memory write, and on
every stop event that finds the store unchanged. Autosave NEVER blocks: an unreachable
remote commits locally and says so. The 60s timeouts cover a slow `git push`; the
PreToolUse path does no network I/O and keeps its 10s.
Drive it: python3 scripts/check_agent_memory_link.py --self-test

hooks.statusMessage: Checking agent-memory symlink + banking the store
